chain.a: On update allocate NEW nodes only along root-to-change path; untouched subtrees shared by pointer. Versioned roots array = time travel; memory O(log n)/update.
Need custom aggregates beyond order (subtree max/sum/xor) — augment fields freely; pb_ds fixed policy set.
Recompute sz/h bottom-up inside fix() for rotated pair ONLY — O(1) maintenance per rotation; forget one field = silent wrong ranks later.
Random priorities + BST keys = expected-balanced without rotation cases; simpler delete; same augmentation story — mention as sibling design.
